charts.title: TrES-3 b: orbits around Pipoltr
charts.description: The orbits of Pipoltr's planets in this map from above, to scale, with TrES-3 b highlighted and the direction to Earth down. Each orbit is the one the app draws, from the published period, a/R*, eccentricity and argument of periastron; the star is a marker, not to scale.

metadata.orbitSource: Sodickson & Grunblatt 2025 (2025ApJ...993...78S), via the NASA Exoplanet Archive ps table (pl_refname SODICKSON__AMP__GRUNBLATT_2025): P 1.30618626966 d

charts.title: TrES-3 b: its transit
charts.description: TrES-3 b crossing its star, as TESS recorded it: 3 sectors (53, 79, 80) of the SPOC pipeline's 2-minute light curves of TIC 116264089, each transit divided by a straight line fitted to the light either side and folded onto the orbit the app draws, then averaged in 6-minute bins. Error bars are each bin's standard error.
notes: Folded on the app's orbit; 6-min bins.
Bars: standard error of each bin.
